### 2. Full-Catalogue Census Findings (H2)

The full analysis scales from the 300-family feasibility pilot to the complete finite catalogue of **1,461 multi-species structural dark families** ($570 \, K$ low-query-TM families with $\text{qTM} < 0.5$; $891 \, Q \setminus K$ fold-matched sequence-dark families with $\text{qTM} \ge 0.5$):

```
                        CONFIDENCE-QUALIFIED UNIVERSE (N = 2,838)
                                    [1,031 K / 1,807 Q\K]
                                             │
                       Refined-MAG Binned: 2,426 [917 K / 1,509 Q\K]
                       Valid dRep Species: 2,378 [898 K / 1,480 Q\K]
                                             │
                      GATE 3 ADMITTED FULL CENSUS (N = 1,461)
                                      [570 K / 891 Q\K]
                                             │
              ┌──────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────┐
              ▼                              ▼                              ▼
     Tier 1: Primary Gate           Tier 2: 3'-Stop Sens           Tier 3: Partial Sens
       (4 exact flanks)             (4 exact/3'-stop)             (>= 1 exact flank)
        n = 353 (24.2%)                n = 637 (43.6%)               n = 1,320 (90.3%)
      [173 K / 180 Q\K]              [260 K / 377 Q\K]               [521 K / 799 Q\K]
```

#### Core Empirical Results

1. **Part (a) Within-Arm Positional Reference Enrichment ($B = 5{,}000$, 7,473 contigs):**
   - Both structural dark arms exhibit robust, non-random flanking KEGG KO recurrence relative to same-contig eligible pseudo-focal positions ($M_c \ge 2$ in 97.1% of loci, median 18.0 positions):
     - **Arm $K$ ($n = 173$ Tier 1 families):** Observed rate $\bar{C}_K^{\text{obs}} = 40.46\%$ (`70 / 173`) vs. same-contig null expectation $\bar{\mu}_K^{\text{pos}} = 8.71\%$ (excess **$+31.75$ percentage points**, $p = 0.0002$; continuous recurrence excess **$+0.3171$**, $p = 0.0002$).
     - **Arm $Q \setminus K$ ($n = 180$ Tier 1 families):** Observed rate $\bar{C}_{Q\setminus K}^{\text{obs}} = 32.22\%$ (`58 / 180`) vs. same-contig null expectation $\bar{\mu}_{Q\setminus K}^{\text{pos}} = 6.56\%$ (excess **$+25.67$ percentage points**, $p = 0.0002$; continuous recurrence excess **$+0.2420$**, $p = 0.0002$).
   - Flanking syntenic recurrence is an empirical feature of desert structural dark families.

2. **Part (b) Between-Arm Covariate-Adjusted Contrast ($K$ vs. $Q \setminus K$):**
   - An apparent unadjusted difference in raw recurrence ($40.46\%$ vs. $32.22\%$, $+8.24$ pp, Fisher exact $p = 0.1214$) is confounded by structural length differences (mean $320.8$ aa in $K$ vs. $233.1$ aa in $Q \setminus K$, $\text{SMD} = +0.6439$) and higher flanking KO annotation opportunity ($0.3839$ vs. $0.3554$, $\text{SMD} = +0.1288$), which directly elevate baseline detection.
   - **Primary Stratified Label Permutation ($B = 10{,}000$, 16/16 common-support strata, 100% coverage):**
     $$\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}}(E_{\mathrm{fam}}) = +0.035358 \quad (\text{Null SD} = 0.042346, \; p = 0.4069)$$
     $$\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}}(C_{\mathrm{fam}}) = +0.053850 \quad (\text{Null SD} = 0.046674, \; p = 0.2598)$$
   - **Tier 2 Sensitivity ($n = 637$ families, 16/16 common-support strata):**
     $$\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}}(E_{\mathrm{fam}}) = +0.018391 \quad (\text{Null SD} = 0.031223, \; p = 0.5618)$$
   - **1:1 Strict Exact-Phylum + Tight-Length Matching ($96$ pairs):**
     Exact zero raw difference ($31.25\%$ vs. $31.25\%$, sign-flip $p = 1.0000$) and null excess contrast ($\Delta_{\mathrm{strict}}(E_{\mathrm{fam}}) = -0.005440, p = 0.9226$).
   - **Multivariable Regression ($n = 353$, rank $9/9$, all models converged):**
     - OLS / HC3 on excess $E_{\mathrm{fam}}$: $\hat{\beta}_{\mathrm{is\_k}} = +0.029446 \pm 0.042950$ ($t = +0.686, p = 0.4930$).
     - MLE Logistic on raw $C_{\mathrm{fam}}$: $\hat{\beta}_{\mathrm{is\_k}} = +0.280149 \pm 0.296352$ ($\text{OR} = 1.3233, p = 0.3445$).
     - L2-Penalized Ridge Logistic ($\lambda = 0.5$): $\text{OR} = 1.3430, p = 0.2890$.
   - **Conclusion:** Conditioned on species breadth, host lineage, and flank KO annotation opportunity, between-arm excess recurrence is statistically indistinguishable from the null.

3. **Cross-Family Dependence Audit & Descriptive Species Resampling:**
   - All $877$ Tier 1 eligible primary loci occupy $869$ unique contigs with **zero overlapping $\pm 2$-flank windows** across structural families.
   - Fixed-outcome species-cluster bootstrap ($B = 2{,}000$, resampling $568$ unique dRep species clusters) yields $\mathrm{SE}_{\mathrm{boot}}(\Delta C_{\mathrm{fam}}) = 0.0353$ and $\mathrm{SE}_{\mathrm{boot}}(\Delta E_{\mathrm{fam}}) = 0.0313$. As mandated, this is explicitly labeled descriptive fixed-outcome reweighting that does not recompute underlying recurrence or eliminate phylogenetic cross-family dependence.
   - Zero-shared-species subset ($n = 112$ families: $51 \, K, 61 \, Q \setminus K$): $\Delta(E_{\mathrm{fam}}) = +0.0634$ ($+0.2619$ vs. $+0.1984$), consistent with full-census estimates.

4. **Flanking Annotations & Mobilome Keyword Bounds:**
   - Across all $128$ Tier 1 conserved families ($70 \, K, 58 \, Q \setminus K$), **`0 / 128` (`0.0%`)** of the top recurrent KOs match the 11-keyword mobilome screen (`best_ko_mobilome_flag == 0`).
   - This screen strictly bounds the annotation of the top recurrent KO itself; it does not claim absence of mobile elements or proof of core housekeeping status, as $62.68\%$ of Tier 1 flanks lack KO annotations (`mapped_noKO`) and many encode hypothetical proteins.

5. **Cryptographic Contig Verification and Attrition Tracking:**
   - **`2,041 / 2,126` (`96.00%`)** refined bins passed uppercase forward-strand nucleotide SHA-256 + Bakta `.log` `orig-id` verification (`0` hash mismatches, `0` RC mismatches across $1,561$ bins with duplicate contig lengths).
   - Exactly **`85 / 2,126` (`4.00%`)** bins lacking Bakta annotation files on IBEX were explicitly catalogued in [`results/pilot_join_metrics.json`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round7_analyses/h2_context/results/pilot_join_metrics.json), and their $108$ primary flanks were cleanly excluded as `source_file_unavailable`.
   - All 11 independent programmatic closure assertions passed (`true`).

### 3. H1 Completeness Audit (Documented in `H1_COMPLETENESS.md`)

- **Assessment Document:** Written to [`H1_COMPLETENESS.md`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round7_analyses/h2_context/H1_COMPLETENESS.md).
- **Primary PGLS ($S1$):** Complete across all $N = 237$ *Thermoplasmatota* species representatives ($\hat{\lambda}_{\mathrm{ML}} = 0.915784$, 95% profile CI $[0.846303, 0.957823]$; $R^2_{\mathrm{GLS}} = 0.469051$; $\beta_{\mathrm{AAI}} = +0.001704 \pm 0.000407, p = 4.07 \times 10^{-5}$; $\beta_{\mathrm{frac\_rbh\_desert}} = -0.137484 \pm 0.019456, p = 1.88 \times 10^{-11}$).
- **Statsmodels Cross-Check:** Verified to machine precision against `statsmodels.GLS` (max $|\Delta \beta| = 5.16 \times 10^{-12}$, max $|\Delta \mathrm{SE}| = 3.15 \times 10^{-13}$, max $|\Delta R^2| = 4.44 \times 10^{-15}$).
- **Seven Sensitivities ($S1$–$S7$):** Fully executed and closed across unnormalized Brownian VCV ($S2$), catalogue denominators ($S3$), dominant class restriction ($S4$), dominant family omission ($S5$), same-class comparators ($S6$), and caller complete-gene proxy ($S7$).
- **Phylogenetic Rooting:** Midpoint rooting and outgroup rooting on 30 Halobacteriota/Thermoproteota taxa proved strictly invariant ($|\Delta| = 0.0$).
- **Finding:** **Zero missing analyses.** The package achieves complete numerical closure; redundant reruns are unnecessary. Existing H1 outputs were preserved untouched.
